integrity: The theorem has a constructive argument for all bi-infinite configurations. An accompanying standard-library finite-ring checker is provided. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the synchronous binary one-active-transition zero erosion family r>=2. Prior process-graph papers from 2017 and 2025 were not fully accessible; historical priority especially for r=2 is unresolved. Finite ring checks do not establish infinite-lattice claims.
title: Exact image filtration and a proper sofic limit for zero-erosion cellular automata
